column1: # Object structure: 25 entries of 80h bytes at DS:745D (JO.EXE), used by JO.EXE and all ENEMYn files.
# Directives: #struct <name> <size>, #apply <program> <segment:offset> <count>. Rows: offset, type, name, comment.

column4: 1 = inside the active area around the camera (objects_activate_by_camera).
Low 7 bits: object kind (contact damage needs kind >= 4); bit 7 is toggled often (facing?). (guess for bit 7)
1 = slot in use.
Sub-state, set and compared with constants. (guess)
1 = gravity applies (object_apply_gravity).
1 = collide with the map (object_map_collision).
Cleared by object_map_collision every frame; 1 = no gravity. (guess)
1 = on the ground (object_stop_on_ground, object_bounce_on_ground).
Bit 7 = hit by a player attack this frame (object_check_attack_hits); low bits cleared there.
1 = touching the object hurts the player (JO enemy_contact_damage).
Movement direction (256 steps, table C90; 80h-FFh = left); object_move_by_direction uses it.
Animation counter, cleared by object_set_state. (guess)
Animation frame, cleared by object_set_state; hit box tables are indexed by it.
Animation counter, cleared by object_set_state. (guess)
Class >= 1Ch is slowed by the time slow weapon. (guess for the other values)
AI handler table group (ENEMYn entry 1 table).
AI handler index in the group.
FFh = never despawn; 1 = clear the spawn flag when despawned.
Speed along the direction, X part (object_move_by_direction).
Speed along the direction, Y part (object_move_by_direction).
Fall speed: gravity adds 1 up to 12 and adds it to velocity_y.
FFh = none; objects with the same group move together (move_linked_objects).
Counted down every frame by JO objects_activate_by_camera.
1 = solid for the player and other objects (object_solid_at_point).
Animation number (object_set_state AL).
Signed hitbox X offset.
Signed hitbox Y offset.
Damage to the player on contact.
Frames in the current state: objects_update adds 1 before the handler; handlers compare it with constants.
X movement this frame (next X = x + velocity_x).
Y movement this frame (next Y = y + velocity_y).
Hitbox half width.
Hitbox height (up from y).
World X position.
16-bit fraction of the X movement (object_move_by_direction).
World Y position (bottom).
16-bit fraction of the Y movement (object_move_by_direction).
Spawn flag index: below 8000h in the flag table DS:82DD, else DS:80DD + (id - 8000h); FFFFh = none.
Second state counter. (guess)
Saved X coordinate. (guess)
Saved Y coordinate. (guess)
